proof_dependency_chain: Derive constants and paired finite observations from naturality.
Use Boolean complement and intersection to construct an actual ultrafilter.
Recover every finite observation from its unique ultrafilter-large fibre and prove the two constructions inverse.
Define pushforward, point records and flattening by observation evaluation.
Prove all functor and monad laws on actual record values and identify the operations with ultrafilter pushforward, pure and join.
Prove finite-test transport agrees on the original universe and is uniquely forced by maps to finite skeletal tests.
Combine point injectivity, finite principal-ultrafilter classification and an actual cofinite-extending ultrafilter to characterize point surjectivity.
boundary_checks: Extend a Yoneda-style point-recovery argument from all sets to only finite tests.
Assume finite observations already distinguish genuine points from all coherent records.
Stop at a natural bijection and omit the nested-record multiplication.

formalization.scope: Actual-object main theorem or complete counterexample, with each reference result itemized in COVERAGE.md.

checks: The record contains every finite test in the specified smaller universe; Boolean tests are used to derive a proper ultrafilter and the full arbitrary finite-fiber rule is recovered.
The natural classification is an actual two-sided equivalence. Functor action, prescribed unit, prescribed multiplication and all monad laws are encoded, with exact evaluation identities.
The finite point-evaluation criterion is proved in both directions, including empty sets and the infinite free-ultrafilter obstruction under classical choice.

The source explicitly extends and uniquely transports finite tests between universes via finite equivalences; no unjustified replacement of all finite tests by only a selected binary interface occurs.
The final task explicitly quantifies X and Y in the larger universe. This is only the scope of the already defined functor and does not add a solution hint.
